_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee koc {player_id} ee Tic Tac Toe ee koc kethii ketharie.
Akonga yin ee '{symbol}'.
Yin ee koc woot yic akonga yin ku pamac ee 5x5 ku kuee yic kuat kethii.
Kuat kethii aaye kuat nhom, kuat cuëër, ku kuat yic koor.
Cëën akïïdë yin ku woot yic kuat yic nhïïm [4] ku wëërë cell 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛmɛ̈th format thok. Lo '[cell]' kɛmɛ̈th ke bɛ̈n 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Thok cell number: {cell}. Kɔc bɛ̈n 0 na {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acï lɔ tueŋ ke cie luɔide.

outcome.draw: Aköl ë yic ee kë ye kɔc thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ!
